integrity: Proof is self-contained; independent finite verification through k=8 supplements but does not establish the universal case. Self-review only.
limitations: The classification concerns only generator-based red-blue colorings of a specified three-parameter circulant family. In negative cases, unrestricted rainbow connection remains unproved; no implication toward the full dense-circulant conjecture is asserted.
title: Sharp generator-based rainbow thresholds for one-outlier circulants
